get.summary: InflationMetrics queries current inflation metrics
LiquidityMiningStats queries liquidity mining statistics
UserMEVBalance queries a user's MEV redistribution balance
MEVStats queries MEV redistribution statistics
Params queries the economics module parameters
Proposals queries all proposals
Proposal queries a proposal by ID
Deposits queries all deposits for a proposal
Deposit queries a deposit by proposal ID and depositor
TallyResult queries the tally of a proposal
Votes queries all votes for a proposal
Vote queries a vote by proposal ID and voter
TokenomicsStats queries overall tokenomics statistics
PendingTreasuryTxs queries all pending treasury transactions
PendingTreasuryTx queries a pending treasury transaction
AllVestingSchedules queries all vesting schedules
VestingSchedulesByAddress queries all vesting schedules for an address
VestingSchedule queries a vesting schedule by ID
VoteDelegations queries all vote delegations for a delegator
VoteLocksByOwner queries all vote locks for an owner
VoteLock queries a vote lock by ID
VotingPower queries the voting power for an address

Coin.description:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
signatures required by gogoproto.

feeBurnPercentage.title: Percentage of fees to burn (basis points)

minFeeMultiplier.title: Fee multiplier range for dynamic adjustment

minLockDuration.title: Minimum lock duration for voting boost

lockMultiplierPerYear.title: Vote power multiplier per year locked (basis points)

irVerifiedMultiplier.title: Reward multiplier for IR-verified users (basis points)

MEVRedistributionStrategy.title: MEVRedistributionStrategy defines how MEV is redistributed

ScheduleType.title: ScheduleType defines who the vesting schedule is for

inflationAlertThreshold.title: Inflation alert threshold (basis points deviation from target)

VestingType.title: VestingType defines the type of vesting

VoteDelegation.title: VoteDelegation represents delegation of voting power

maxHoldingPercentage.title: Maximum holding percentage (basis points of total supply)

largeTxThreshold.title: Threshold for large transaction (basis points of total supply)

v1beta1.Deposit.title: Deposit represents a deposit on a proposal

v1beta1.Params.title: Params defines the unified economics module parameters

v1beta1.PendingTreasuryTx.title: PendingTreasuryTx represents a pending treasury transaction

isEmergency.title: Whether this is an emergency proposal

v1beta1.TallyResult.title: TallyResult represents the tally of a proposal

isSecret.title: Whether this is a secret ballot

v1beta1.Vote.title: Vote represents a vote on a proposal

v1beta1.VoteLock.title: VoteLock represents locked tokens for voting
